newsitem.title: UK: No UK election announcement imminent - sources.
newsitem.headline: No UK election announcement imminent - sources.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major is not due to make any announcement on Wednesday or to hold a meeting with journalists, sources at Conservative Party headquarters and at his Downing Street office said.
Rumours had been circulating in London's financial markets that an announcement, possibly about an election date, was imminent.
"The Prime Minister is busy in meetings this afternoon and there are certainly no plans for a press conference," a spokesman in Downing Street said.
